==Description==
To be placed before sections of articles that describe the "light side" choices occurring during optional content in a game. Description of light side choices occurring during the main questline of a game should instead use {{Tl|GameLS}}.

==Usage==
Use the format <code><nowiki>{{GameLSmechanics|</nowiki>{{Var|Name of game}}}}</code> for a specific game. The {{Para|canon|1}} parameter should be used for [[Canon]] articles. Close assumption sections with {{Tl|Endgame}}.
